text: Vale, Lumen, and Reed pick the fountain and each other over Flint's cold "just the facts" routine — while Flint drags Vale off to the sluice gate anyway, insisting the water numbers matter more than feelings. Dusk goes full doomsayer, convincing Vale that Sector Alpha's supply lines are secretly about controlling information, not grain, and recruits her to spy on the docks — then pivots to inviting her to the kelp farm instead to watch quietly for signs the Islands are breaking. Reed's unsettling calm keeps spreading — even the gulls go quiet and kelp farmer Elsie still won't wave — and Vale drops the big reveal: the water below Sector Alpha has been acting weird for three straight days, setting up a tense split tomorrow between the fountain crew (Reed, Lumen, maybe Vale), Flint's sluice-gate investigation, and Dusk's secret kelp-farm stakeout.
